## Checklist

- [ ] Sidecar `catalog/plugins/<name>.toml` added or updated (owner, status, when_to_use, avoid_when)
- [ ] Marketplace entry has a description of at least 30 characters, a category and tags from `catalog/taxonomy.toml`
- [ ] `ccshelf lint` and `ccshelf compile --check` pass locally or in CI
- [ ] Hooks or `.mcp.json` added or changed: explain what runs and why (the platform team reviews these)
